blocks.text: Ube and matcha have found their way into everything from drinks and desserts to new takes on familiar favorites. This October, Salu Salo Market brings the two together at the Ube Matcha Fest, a four-day bazaar happening from October 14 to 17, 2026, at SMDC Light Mall, Mandaluyong. The event will feature a selection of local brands offering food and beverages, fashion, accessories, lifestyle finds, and more. Visitors can look forward to discovering new favorites, trying different ube and matcha creations, and exploring the work of local entrepreneurs.
